name: diagnose-website-connections
description: Diagnose a website's connection and attribute problems to the server, your internet connection, or the network path between them.

scripts.//lint: One ESLint pass from the root, not a Turbo task: the config is a single flat config covering the whole workspace, and no package defines its own lint script.
scripts.verify: pnpm run format:check && turbo run build && pnpm run lint && turbo run typecheck test
